description: Check a regex for catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) WITHOUT running it on any text: static analysis with recheck, the same engine the Jarroba Tools /regex page uses. Says whether the pattern is safe, exponential or polynomial (with its degree), which part of the pattern is to blame, and an attack string that triggers it. For the two shapes people type by accident — nested quantifiers like (a+)+ and (\w+\s?)+ — it proposes a rewrite, re-analyses it, and only offers it if it is actually better, saying what it becomes. Use it right after writing a regex that will run on untrusted input.
name: regex_redos_check
